infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zob Connect uses your camera to take a live photo when you clock in or out, confirming it is you.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zob Connect lets you choose an existing photo when you upload an identity document or set your profile picture.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Zob Connect checks your location about every 12 minutes while you are clocked in — including when the app is closed — to confirm you are at your assigned store. It stops when your shift ends.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Zob Connect checks your location when you clock in or out, to confirm you are at your assigned store.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Zob Connect checks your location about every 12 minutes while you are clocked in — including when the app is closed — to confirm you are at your assigned store. It stops when your shift ends.

plugins.photosPermission: Zob Connect lets you choose an existing photo when you upload an identity document or set your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Zob Connect uses your camera to photograph your identity documents and to take a live photo when you clock in or out.
